purpose: Hand-maintained sign-off on every decision flip between the rules at commit 35ff226 and the iteration-18 rules. scripts/check_routing_reachability.py joins this onto the generated flip table and FAILS on any flip that is not reviewed here, on any entry that no longer corresponds to a flip, and on any verdict of REJECT. A flip count on its own is not a review; this file is the review.

verdicts.ACCEPT: the new route is better for this task, not merely consistent with the new rule
verdicts.REJECT: the new route is worse -- fix the rule or the label, do not record the flip
verdicts.UNCERTAIN: defensible either way; recorded so it is re-read next time the rule moves

how_the_rule_column_is_produced: Not by hand. scripts/check_routing_reachability.py switches exactly one iteration-18 delta off at a time and reports which one restores the old route, so the attribution cannot rot when a rule changes.
